meta.description: Single source of truth for reverse-skill task routing. master-route.ps1 / verify-routing-coherence.ps1 / test-routing.ps1 / extract-summaries.ps1 all read from this file. When changing routing rules, edit only this file — do not edit routing tables scattered across markdown / ps1 files (documentation is maintained by generation scripts, or must at least stay consistent with this file).
meta.scoring: Each matching keyword rule adds its route to the candidate set; the route with the highest hit score becomes PRIMARY, following priority-array order; on a score tie the route earlier in the priority array wins; when no rule matches, fall back to fallbackId.
maintainers: The priority table in skills/MASTER-ROUTING.md maps one-to-one to the priority field in this file
